'''Sea Castle Resort Hotel''' was a deluxe hotel suite on the water planet [[Praya]], during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The hotel was given the rating of five stars by the [[Milky Way Guide]], and as such was among the highest ranking hotels in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sea Castle was mentioned in the post-ride queue video on the [[Tourscan]] for the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride and was depicted through the use of footage of the Sea Castle optional ending of the former [[Wikipedia:Epcot|Epcot]] attraction [[Wikipedia:Horizons (Epcot)|''Horizons'']].<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=VNC_xzE7Y54|text=Tour Scan in ''Star Tours'' at Tokyo Disneyland|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
